name: @laticent/segno-markdown
description: The deck model for Lattice-flavored Markdown: one CommonMark block pass (markdown-it's block rules, matched token for token) writing a flat tape, with slides, slide boundaries, front matter, directive, fence and leaf ranges read off it, and an incremental re-parse that re-reads only the edited slide. Zero dependencies, no DOM, no Node.
author: Sharmarke Aden (Laticent) <sharmarke.aden@gmail.com>
